FanControl.LianLi v{{VERSION}} ({{VARIANT}} build)

Requires FanControl V243 or newer.

Install:
  1. Unblock the DLL: right-click {{DLL}} -> Properties -> tick 'Unblock' -> OK.
     Windows blocks files downloaded from the internet and FanControl
     silently ignores a blocked plugin.
  2. In FanControl, open the menu, click 'Install plugin', and pick {{DLL}}.
     It loads straight away with no restart.

  That single DLL is all you need. To upgrade later, do the same with
  the new DLL; your curves stay bound.

Do not run Lian Li L-Connect at the same time. Both drive the same
devices, and the wireless dongles can only be open in one program.
Keep L-Connect installed (the plugin reads what you saved in it), but
switch its service off: in services.msc set 'L-Connect Service' to
Disabled and stop it (and 'L-Connect Service Watcher' too, if an older
L-Connect left it there), then restart 'FanControl Service'. The README
has the exact PowerShell commands:
https://github.com/lewisgibson/FanControl.LianLi#using-it-with-l-connect
